question_text: Outline how a transaction can avoid leaving only half of an account transfer in a database when an update fails.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Treat the debit and credit as one transaction. Commit both if successful; otherwise roll back the uncommitted changes so neither half remains.

marking_points.criterion: Both updates form one all-or-nothing transaction.
Commit both or roll back failed partial updates.
